scope: Printed EndOfAttack carrier scoping; no cloud/runtime or model contract change

red.note: Three original negative test functions plus one six-card aggregate negative fail. All six added positive card controls pass.

green_card_regressions.note: This combined attempt subsequently stopped on two faulty synthetic control fixtures, which were corrected. Do not report the entire combined attempt as passing.

scope_controls: native broad observers plus scheduled processing
clone and field compaction after actual simultaneous observer resolves
departed attacker cannot transfer printed trigger to compacted bystander
pre-declaration cancellation cannot trigger printed carrier timing
unsuccessful declared attack still triggers its surviving carrier
limits: Broader phase/delay changes owned by another agent need their own validation
No inference about corrected win-rate magnitude
